# Nave logo files: licence and use

**The files in this folder are not covered by the MIT licence.** A file's
licence is normally assumed to be the repository's, so this note says plainly
that these ones are not: `logo-horizontal-noorbit.light.svg` and
`logo-horizontal-noorbit.dark.svg` are the Nave compass mark with the NaveCSS
name, and a mark is not code.

"NaveCSS" and the Nave compass mark are trademarks of the NaveCSS project, and
their use is governed by [TRADEMARKS.md](../../TRADEMARKS.md). In short: you may
display the mark unmodified and scaled proportionally to say that something is
built with NaveCSS, without implying endorsement or affiliation, and not as your
own logo or part of one. You may not modify it otherwise.

These two files are here so that this repository's README can show the logo.
They are not the full asset set: see "The assets" in TRADEMARKS.md for where
that lives.

Do not add these files to a published `@navecss/*` package, and keep this note
beside them wherever they are copied.
